# wrapv1

```go
import wrapv1 "pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/http/wrap/v1"
```

Package wrapv1 is the http.wrap/v1 contract: middleware around everything a multisite host serves (a Server-Timing header, request logging). Wrappers nest in provider order: the first is the outermost.

A host-scope service contract: providers register on the host's scope (ProvideIn), not on an app.

Source: [`ext/contracts/http/wrap/v1`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts/http/wrap/v1).

## Variables

<a id="contract"></a>

```go
var Contract = extkit.NewContract[Wrapper]("http.wrap/v1", extkit.Many)
```

## Types

### Wrapper
